description: This file defines the BatchClient class in the Aws\Batch namespace, which extends AwsClient to provide an interface for interacting with the AWS Batch service. It includes method annotations for various AWS Batch operations and their asynchronous counterparts.

classes.name: BatchClient
classes.description: A client for interacting with the AWS Batch service, providing methods for job management and other batch operations.

methods.name: cancelJob
methods.description: Cancels a specified job in AWS Batch.

methods.name: createComputeEnvironment
methods.description: Creates a new compute environment in AWS Batch.

methods.name: createJobQueue
methods.description: Creates a new job queue in AWS Batch.

methods.name: describeComputeEnvironments
methods.description: Describes one or more compute environments.

methods.name: describeJobDefinitions
methods.description: Describes one or more job definitions.

methods.name: describeJobQueues
methods.description: Describes one or more job queues.

methods.name: getJobQueueSnapshot
methods.description: Retrieves a snapshot of the job queue.

methods.name: submitJob
methods.description: Submits a job to AWS Batch.
